remarks: Nestled on a knoll with a supreme sense of space and privacy, this modernized hills escape has been completely transformed into a zen paradise! Perched up above the street on a 15,000+sf lot, the front walk beckons towards the stunning wood door entrance and into the open concept living room with stone fireplace. Stunning wood floors and premium quality solid wood doors and wood-frame windows exemplify the organic and artistic ethos of the hills, while walls of windows showcase the outdoor surroundings and bring in abundant natural light.
